quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x7928

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, this bottle feels heavy. Seems like there's something inside it...

dialogues.speaker: Drifting Bottle
dialogues.text: "An old friend of ours came over yesterday bearing ill tidings..."

dialogues.speaker: Drifting Bottle
dialogues.text: "I have not received a reply from you in a long while. Perhaps he is right, and I should accept reality."

dialogues.speaker: Drifting Bottle
dialogues.text: "But nonetheless, if you are still wandering the land, should you receive this missive, I hope that you can send me a reply."

dialogues.speaker: Drifting Bottle
dialogues.text: "Attach your insignia to your letter, that I may recognize you by its presence when the time comes."

dialogues.speaker: Drifting Bottle
dialogues.text: "Do you remember Uyuu Restaurant? We shall meet there. You will find money for wine attached herein."

dialogues.speaker: Drifting Bottle
dialogues.text: "But if you are not the one I was expecting to receive this letter..."

dialogues.speaker: Drifting Bottle
dialogues.text: "Then please, take this keepsake all the same. Perhaps you might be able to find its original owner for me — do also take the Mora in here as thanks."
